known_pitfall_claim: The proof incorrectly types the inverse of the homeomorphism φ: U → V as φ⁻¹: U → V; its domain and codomain must instead be V and U, respectively.
pitfall_counterexample: Let U = V = the one-point discrete space {⋆}, and let φ(⋆)=⋆. Then φ:U→V is a homeomorphism and φ⁻¹(⋆)=⋆. Because U and V are definitionally the same space, φ⁻¹ has both displayed types V→U and U→V. Thus the quoted annotation is not incorrect in this instance.
